name: Washington
note: Washington has no state income tax on wages; take-home pay is federal income tax and FICA plus the state payroll programs below.

items.label: Paid Family and Medical Leave
items.note: Total premium 1.13% of wages up to the Social Security wage base; employees pay 71.43% of it (the employer pays 28.57%).

items.label: WA Cares long-term care
items.note: 0.58% of all wages. Employees with approved exemptions do not pay it.

sources.title: WAC 388-478-0015 - Need standards for cash assistance
ESSB 6346, Sec. 314 - One million dollar standard deduction
